extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media professionals, and members of the public seeking RAND press materials or media contacts
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and contact information for engaging RAND's press office, finding RAND experts for media comment, and RAND's policy on commentary submissions. Includes site organization of press-related content (Press, Commentary, Article) and subscription options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commentary submission policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note that RAND only publishes commentary by RAND researchers. We do not accept outside submissions or guest posts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: External authors cannot submit guest commentary; only RAND researchers' commentary will be published.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media contact / response expectation
rubrics_metrics.description: Thank you for reaching out to RAND's media team. We will respond if we can accommodate your request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact RAND Media Relations at media@rand.org. For European media inquiries contact europeanmedia@randeurope.org or +44 (1223) 353 329. Response is conditional on the team's ability to accommodate the request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find an Expert — expert availability for media
rubrics_metrics.description: Hundreds of RAND experts are available to speak to the media on topics relevant to the current public policy debate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 'Find an Expert' service to locate and request RAND researchers for media interviews or commentary on relevant public policy topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content type labels (Press, Commentary, Article)
rubrics_metrics.description: Latest News and Commentary — site content is organized into content types such as Press, Commentary, and Article (examples show items labeled 'Press', 'Commentary', 'Article').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press-related communications and announcements appear under 'Press'; analytic/opinion pieces appear as 'Commentary' (which are restricted to RAND researchers); longer pieces appear as 'Article'. Choose/expect the appropriate label for different kinds of content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription / staying informed
rubrics_metrics.description: Subscribe to the Policy Currents newsletter
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sign up for RAND's Policy Currents newsletter to stay up to date on the latest commentary and news from RAND experts.
